text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: —Passing the 400m mark! They've rounded the fourth corner and hit the homestretch!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —Yaaaaaaah!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista is charging hard on the outside!! Buena Vista!!
They're neck and neck!! Side-by-side across the finish line!!

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"...Following an inquiry, Buena Vista
veered outward at the 4th corner,
obstructing the path of another Umamusume—"

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text: “She will be demoted to 3rd place.”
(Murmur, murmur, murmur, murmur...!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: After everyone cheered for me so much... how could this happen?!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry—

text_block_list.name: Buena Fan A
text_block_list.text: Buena Vistaaaaa!!!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"It's okayyy!! There's always next timeee!!
So don't cryyy!!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Fan B
text_block_list.text: Keep giving it your allllll!! I'll always, always be cheering you on!!"å»

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Everyone...――

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...You're still placing your hopes on me—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...I have to deliver...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —I am truly, terribly sorry for today!!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I will continue to do my very best...!
So—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Even someone like me... I'd be so happy
if you'd continue watching over me!!
(WOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text: —"Buena Vista, who narrowly lost at the Shuka Sho the other day, has officially announced her sights are set on the Arima Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Standing in our way will surely be Dream Journey,
who has demonstrated unshakeable strength
ever since claiming victory in the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: "Still, judging by her popularity with the public, wouldn't being voted the number one favorite for the Arima Kinen be totally within reach?"

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
“—She's been the overwhelming favorite all this time, after all.
Even looking back in history, this kind of
idol-like popularity is truly rare.”

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"Will she truly make the fans' dreams come true
at the Arima Kinen?
All eyes will certainly be upon her—"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Phew—
choice_data_list: Alright, that pacing went exactly as planned!
Alright, the pace distribution went just as I planned!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
The precision has improved considerably.
Now then, let us move the simulation to the next phase—
—The tension's building up nicely.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to interrupt you two.
Got a second?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It's Golshi-chan and Nakayama's
Very First Errand, ya hear~?
Treat us real nice, will ya!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Is something the matter...
both of you?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I ran into someone unusual earlier.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I was asked to give this to you.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —No way.
It was a familiar scene. It reminded me of when Mejiro McQueen had suddenly brought a message just like this before.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Big sis—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And so, what's it say~?
Is it the top-secret cart noodle recipe~?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —"Have you found it yet?"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...'I'll be waiting'—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...That is everything written here.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The hell! You're as dry as ever~
Even light salt ramen ain't this crisp!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Still, you seem pretty satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
She is watching.
She is waiting.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Just that............ is enough.

The moment Dream Journey uttered those words,
the setting sun shone intensely, momentarily blinding my vision—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen.
You're gonna face that young lady, right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'd sure love to see it.
How your running is gonna take down the best Umamusume of my generation.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu—
Very well, I shall show you to your heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: And... I'll let you all know as well.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Who will get the closest to "Big Sis"—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: And whether they have surpassed it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Heehーー

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—What the heck?
This one over here is way too rich and heavy.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Make it fun enough that I'll wanna lick my bowl clean.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Look forward to it—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Honestly, that Big Sis of ours...

"The 'streak of gold' that had eluded me for so long.
A hint to its true identity—"
Or perhaps, that very thing itself.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...I suppose they are currently testing it out.
—That night.
While working alone in the trainer's office—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I'm coming in.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —You may remain as you are.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ――You have done well.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Your efforts
were far from mediocre in my sister's eyes.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Elder Sister is trying to change so much.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Never forget.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Do your best, at least.

Exuding an air that brooks no argument,
Orfevre walked out of the Trainer's office.

"And I, too,
couldn't bring myself to chase after her..."
choice_data_list: ...So she's trying to change so much, huh.

text_block_list.text:
...Before anyone realized it, Dream Journey's running
had come to embody so many things—

Turning bonds into strength,
pushing forward on this "journey"—

Now, carrying the hopes of her fans as well,
she seeks to fulfill that dream—
It has been such an unimaginable change... such a "journey" since back then—
Yes, I can't help but reflect on that.

And in the upcoming Arima Kinen,
what kind of transformation would take place...?
choice_data_list: I wonder if Orfevre is looking forward to it too

text_block_list.text:
...And only then, as her words of appreciation sink in,
a gentle warmth of joy begins to well up inside.
That I am Dream Journey's Trainer.
Now at last, I felt like I could hold my head high—
